ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram includes organisms labeled Hawk, Lizard, Grasshopper, Rabbit, Grass, Mouse, and Snake. The Hawk is shown on the left, and several arrows from other animals point toward it. No higher predator is shown receiving an arrow from the Hawk. Reasoning: In a food web, the main predator is the organism that eats other organisms and is not shown as prey for another organism. Since the Hawk receives arrows from multiple prey paths and has no predator above it in the diagram, it is the main predator.
